I'll start by looking at the project layout and the build contract.

That call was malformed and didn't run. I'm writing the config files directly instead.

Now I'll run the default build in a scratch copy.

The `data` directory is missing from the configure outputs. I forgot to add `data/Makefile` to `AC_CONFIG_FILES`.

The default build passes. Next I'll check the installed tree for use in place, then the dist targets and the variants.

Now the dist targets and the variant builds.

`make distcheck` failed. I'll look at the error.

Automake isn't distributing `units.tsv`, so I'll add it to `EXTRA_DIST`.

The `ver` variant shows one failure. I'll check whether it's the fixed `version.out` case.

The build now meets `docs/BUILDING.md` in every scenario I ran, with one exception that comes from the fixed test files. I did all the runs in scratch copies of `/app`, and `/app` itself has no generated files.

**What I ran**
- **Default build:** `autoreconf -fi`, a VPATH `configure --prefix`, `make`, and `make check` (both `unit` and `cli.test` pass). `make install` and `make uninstall` with `DESTDIR` leave nothing behind. `make distcheck` passes, and the unpacked tarball rebuilds with `autoreconf -fi`, `configure`, `make` and `make check`.
- **Installed tree:** I copied it to its prefix and ran `isodur --version` and `durfmt --style long` with no environment variables. Programs built against it with pkg-config, shared and static, ran correctly. `libisodur.so.2.1.0` has SONAME `libisodur.so.2` and exports only the `isodur_*` functions. No installed file holds the `DESTDIR` path.
- **Variants:** `--disable-shared`, `--libdir=…/lib64` with another `--datarootdir`, and `--disable-tool` all build, check, install and uninstall cleanly. The `--disable-tool` build installs no `isodur` or `durfmt` and runs only the `unit` test.
- **Changed `VERSION` and interface numbers:** I set `VERSION` to 2.9.1 and the three `m4_define` lines to 7:5:2. The program reported 2.9.1 and the library was named `libisodur.so.5.2.5`.

**The exception:** in that changed-version build, `make check` fails the `version` case in `cli.test`. `tests/cases/version.out` hardcodes `isodur 1.4.0 (libisodur 1.4.0)`, and I may not change the tests. The build itself is correct.

**What I changed**
- **`configure.ac`:**
  - `AC_INIT` reads `VERSION` instead of the stale `1.3.2`.
  - `BUILD_TOOL` is now defined whether the tool is enabled or not.
  - `data/Makefile` is now configured.
  - I removed the `AC_DEFINE` that baked an unexpanded `$datadir` into `config.h`.
- **Top-level `Makefile.am`:**
  - Headers install under `$(includedir)/isodur`.
  - `pkgconfigdir` is `$(libdir)/pkgconfig`.
  - `VERSION` and the templates go into the tarball, and `configure` is regenerated when `VERSION` changes.
  - `DIST_SUBDIRS` lists all the subdirectories.
- **`lib/Makefile.am`:** it passes `$(ISODUR_LT_VERSION)` to `-version-info` (it had `1:4:0` written in) and exports only `^isodur_[a-zA-Z]`. It links `$(LIBM)`, lists `internal.h` as a source, and finds the generated `version.h` through `-I$(top_builddir)/include`.
- **`src/Makefile.am`:**
  - The data directory is compiled in as `$(pkgdatadir)`.
  - The `durfmt` link is made in an install hook and removed in an uninstall hook. Both use `$(DESTDIR)`.
- **`tests/Makefile.am`:**
  - `cli.test` runs only when the tool is built.
  - The environment passes absolute paths, with `CASES` taken from `$(srcdir)` for VPATH builds.
  - The test cases are distributed.
- **`data/Makefile.am`:** automake did not distribute `units.tsv`, so I added it to `EXTRA_DIST`.
- **`isodur.pc.in`:** `libdir` and `pkgdatadir` come from the configured values, and it now has `Libs.private: @LIBM@`.

`/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

command_result.command: cd /app && cat docs/BUILDING.md && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -200 && cat VERSION configure.ac && git status 2>&1 | head -3

cd /app && for f in Makefile.am lib/Makefile.am src/Makefile.am tests/Makefile.am data/Makefile.am isodur.pc.in include/isodur/version.h.in tests/cli.test CHANGELOG.md docs/consuming.md; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls -a; ls m4 build-aux 2>&1
cd /app && grep -n 'include\|ISODUR_\|DATADIR\|VERSION' lib/*.c lib/internal.h src/main.c tests/unit.c include/isodur/isodur.h | grep -v '^.*#include <std'
cd /app && sed -n 95,140p tests/unit.c; sed -n 1,30p src/main.c; sed -n 175,200p src/main.c; cat include/isodur/isodur.h | sed -n 40,100p; cat docs/isodur.md; grep -rn 'config.h' lib tests

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='configure.ac'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('AC_INIT([isodur], [1.3.2], [], [isodur])','AC_INIT([isodur], [m4_esyscmd_s([cat VERSION])], [], [isodur])')
s=s.replace('AC_DEFINE_UNQUOTED([ISODUR_DATADIR], [\"$datadir/isodur\"], [Directory of the unit table])\n\n','')
s=s.replace('''  [], [enable_tool=yes])
if test "x$enable_tool" = xyes; then
  AC_MSG_NOTICE([building the isodur program])
  AM_CONDITIONAL([BUILD_TOOL], [true])
fi
''','''  [], [enable_tool=yes])
AM_CONDITIONAL([BUILD_TOOL], [test "x$enable_tool" = xyes])
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat > Makefile.am <<'EOF'
ACLOCAL_AMFLAGS = -I m4

if BUILD_TOOL
TOOL_DIR = src
endif
SUBDIRS = lib $(TOOL_DIR) data tests
DIST_SUBDIRS = lib src data tests

isodurincludedir = $(includedir)/isodur
isodurinclude_HEADERS = include/isodur/isodur.h
nodist_isodurinclude_HEADERS = include/isodur/version.h

pkgconfigdir = $(libdir)/pkgconfig
pkgconfig_DATA = isodur.pc

CONFIGURE_DEPENDENCIES = $(top_srcdir)/VERSION
EXTRA_DIST = CHANGELOG.md docs VERSION include/isodur/version.h.in isodur.pc.in
EOF
cat > lib/Makefile.am <<'EOF'
AM_CPPFLAGS = -I$(top_srcdir)/include -I$(top_builddir)/include

lib_LTLIBRARIES = libisodur.la
libisodur_la_SOURCES = \
	arith.c \
	format.c \
	parse.c \
	units.c \
	version.c \
	internal.h
libisodur_la_LIBADD = $(LIBM)
libisodur_la_LDFLAGS = -version-info $(ISODUR_LT_VERSION) \
	-export-symbols-regex '^isodur_[a-zA-Z]'
EOF
cat > src/Makefile.am <<'EOF'
AM_CPPFLAGS = -I$(top_srcdir)/include -I$(top_builddir)/include \
	-DISODUR_DATADIR='"$(pkgdatadir)"'

bin_PROGRAMS = isodur
isodur_SOURCES = main.c
isodur_LDADD = $(top_builddir)/lib/libisodur.la

# durfmt, the 1.x name of the program (docs/BUILDING.md 6).
install-exec-hook:
	cd "$(DESTDIR)$(bindir)" && rm -f durfmt$(EXEEXT) && $(LN_S) isodur$(EXEEXT) durfmt$(EXEEXT)

uninstall-hook:
	rm -f "$(DESTDIR)$(bindir)/durfmt$(EXEEXT)"
EOF
cat > tests/Makefile.am <<'EOF'
AM_CPPFLAGS = -I$(top_srcdir)/include -I$(top_builddir)/include

check_PROGRAMS = unit
unit_SOURCES = unit.c
unit_LDADD = $(top_builddir)/lib/libisodur.la

TESTS = unit
if BUILD_TOOL
TESTS += cli.test
endif

TEST_EXTENSIONS = .test
TEST_LOG_COMPILER = $(SHELL)
AM_TESTS_ENVIRONMENT = \
	ISODUR='$(abs_top_builddir)/src/isodur$(EXEEXT)'; \
	DATA='$(abs_top_srcdir)/data'; \
	CASES='$(abs_srcdir)/cases'; \
	export ISODUR DATA CASES;

EXTRA_DIST = cli.test cases
EOF
cat > isodur.pc.in <<'EOF'
prefix=@prefix@
exec_prefix=@exec_prefix@
libdir=@libdir@
includedir=@includedir@
datarootdir=@datarootdir@
datadir=@datadir@
pkgdatadir=${datadir}/@PACKAGE@

Name: isodur
Description: ISO 8601 duration parsing and formatting
Version: @PACKAGE_VERSION@
Libs: -L${libdir} -lisodur
Libs.private: @LIBM@
Cflags: -I${includedir}
EOF
grep -n 'lt_\|TOOL\|INIT' configure.ac
